issues.what: The hypothetical 'Rewriting every box … would take far longer' visibly overwrites the photo's real data. A white beam turns box 021's cyan Bits grey: the cyan-pixel fraction in 021 falls from 0.37 at f4880 to about 0.09 between f4928 and f4976, all 4 Bits are grey at f4950, and one Bit of 022 is grey at f4950-4984. After the whip at f4992, 021 is fully cyan again (f5000, f5050) with no undo shown. This contradicts 'Nothing opens the boxes' and HDD_DELETED, and it breaks continuity for S4, which needs 021's header glyph and the temporary-file write on 022.
issues.fix: Draw the rewrite as a what-if that never touches the Archive state: a translucent, dashed ghost overlay or a separate strip above the wall that crawls and then stops on 'longer' (f4957). Alternatively, fade the hypothetical grey back to cyan before the f4992 whip. Keep 021-023 cyan in every frame of S3.

issues.what: Each spoken field name appears twice at once: the card's printed field name pops into a pill, and a separate hud chip with the same word appears next to it. At f3586 'directions' is on screen twice (a pill on the card header plus a hud chip with a leader at the top right), and 'dates' is on screen twice (a pill plus a fading hud chip at the left). At f3527-3530, 'name' and 'size' are each doubled. The result is redundant clutter on the card that is meant to teach four fields.
issues.fix: Keep one cue per field: the hud chip at the field anchor, with the card's own field name only bolded or filled. Exit each chip when the next field is spoken.
